Proof in the paper: The −COOH group is suitable to interact with the dominant orientation (110) of the rutile TiO2 surface, where the Ti···Ti distance of 3 Å allows for a stable bridging configuration, as seen by numerous studies, including scanning tunnelling microscopy, electron-stimulated desorption ion angle distribution/low energy electron diffraction, IR, near edge X-ray absorption fine structure, X-ray photoelectron diffraction, and density functional theory computation.
